items.name: morluto/rea
items.one_liner: Reverse engineer apps and binaries with AI agents
items.pain_point: Saves time for developers and security researchers by automating reverse engineering, valuable for enterprises and startups
app_ideas: Reverse Engineering as a Service: A web app where users upload binaries and get a report with behavior analysis
Binary Analysis Tool: A CLI tool for developers to analyze binaries locally
Security Research Platform: A platform for security researchers to collaborate and share findings
items.monetization: Freemium with enterprise pricing for advanced features and support
items.why_now: Increased demand for reverse engineering tools due to the rise of AI and the need for cybersecurity solutions
